characters.name: Aurelian Valdris
characters.title: The Lion of Solhaven
characters.visuals: Silver-streaked golden hair, piercing amber eyes, short trimmed royal beard, broad-shouldered muscular physique with a veteran's scar across his sculpted chest.

wardrobe.state_c_camp: Unlaced white silk tunic open to the sternum with gold embroidery, sleeves rolled up over muscular forearms, studying maps over a drafting table.

lore.secret: Two decades ago, Aurelian sealed the first rift at great personal cost, sacrificing his own family lineage's security to keep the peace.

bond_arc.rank_1: Reviewing battle doctrines and the ancient history of House Aurelis.
bond_arc.rank_2: Reflecting on the heavy moral weight and sacrifices of royal command.
bond_arc.rank_3: A midnight discussion on monarchical duty and the fading seal beneath the stone.
bond_arc.rank_4: Oath of Fellowship: Naming you Chief Marshal of Aurelis.

characters.name: Lysandra Verel

bond_arc.rank_1: Tactical sparring session calibrating swift rapier parries.
bond_arc.rank_2: Discussing the moral cost of command and fallen squires from the border skirmishes.

characters.name: Sir Brannoch Haldane

wardrobe.state_c_camp: Open-chested linen vest with leather arm braces, carving wood figurines for his squad.

bond_arc.rank_1: Armor maintenance and sharing defensive battle history.
bond_arc.rank_2: Sharing stories of border defense and his philosophical outlook on survival.
bond_arc.rank_3: Expressing his protective fears for the vanguard frontlines.
bond_arc.rank_4: Oath of Fellowship: Swearing an unbreakable shield-oath as your sworn protector.

characters.name: Kestrel Rowan

bond_arc.rank_3: Sharing personal memories of her lost sibling and why she refuses to abandon comrades.
bond_arc.rank_4: Rank 4 CG: A windswept dawn flight salute overlooking the Thronefield, her cropped riding jacket fluttering open in the updraft.

characters.name: Tamsin Haldane

characters.visuals: Honey-blonde braided hair, wide determined amber eyes, youthful yet surprisingly curvy figure with a full bust and shapely thighs.

bond_arc.rank_3: Private tactical sparring where she masters the advance shield step.
bond_arc.rank_4: Oath of Allegiance: Swearing her spear to your personal vanguard detachment.

characters.name: Malachar Voss

bond_arc.rank_3: Examining ancient concord scrolls and the corrupted runes beneath the stone.
bond_arc.rank_4: Oath of Fellowship: Declaring you the Arch-Strategist of Umbrenholt.

characters.name: Nyssara Vael

characters.visuals: Sultry, aristocratic beauty with a lavish hourglass figure, glossy raven hair bound in an intricate braided crown, bedroom-lidded violet eyes, beauty mark beneath her left eye, and a calculating, seductive expression.
